events.verdict: Mobley (CLE) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Lillard's (MIL) driving shot attempt. The contact that occurs with Lillard's arm is marginal and after the release of the layup.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) steps laterally and initiates hip to body contact with Mobley (CLE), affecting his drive to the basket and shot attempt.

Okoro (CLE) and Antetokounmpo (MIL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and mutual marginal contact occurs. The contact is a result of normal rebounding pursuit and does not impede either player from pursuing the rebound.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) initiates contact with Allen's (CLE) arm, which affects his post shot attempt.

Lopez (MIL) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Mitchell's (CLE) driving shot attempt. The collision is compounded after Mitchell uses his off arm to protect himself at the rim.

Mobley (CLE) is retreating as he defends Antetokounmpo's (MIL) driving shot attempt. Mobley's collapsed forearm absorbs the contact that occurs as they meet after Antetokounmpo gathers to attempt the layup.
Lopez (MIL) cleanly blocks Allen's (CLE) shot attempt near the rim.
While defending the drive, Antetokounmpo (MIL) makes marginal contact with Mitchell's (CLE) shoulder on the play. The contact dissolves prior to Mitchell's (CLE) shot attempt.
Lopez (MIL) firms up in Allen's (CLE) path and does not deliver illegal contact during the screen.
Mobley (CLE) inbounds the ball in under 5 seconds.
Trent Jr. (MIL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Mitchell (CLE) during the drive.
Trent Jr. (MIL) legally contests Mitchell's (CLE) jump shot attempt.
Portis (MIL) and Okoro (CLE) mutually engage and quickly disengage with one another during the screen.
Okoro (CLE) legally contests Lillard's (MIL) jump shot attempt.
